data.narrative:
DEFCON AI is a Seed-stage defense and security AI company that has raised $44M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning Seed through Series A stages within the Defense & Security sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $44M total raised as a value proxy and applies a typical 2.5x multiplier for progression from Seed to the next stage, yielding $110M. Peer-median analysis examines four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A), with a median of $700M. This wider peer range reflects material heterogeneity in the Defense & Security subsector at similar stages.

The triangulated valuation range is $94M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $405M. The 8.5x spread between low and high endpoints reflects the substantial variance in peer valuations—particularly the $4.0B outlier in the comp set—and uncertainty around DEFCON AI's relative positioning within the Defense & Security market. Stage-progression anchors the lower bound; peer medians anchor the upper range. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, differentiation versus the Anduril/Shield AI cohort, and defense procurement pathway clarity.
